rows: What did the Frankfurt Book Fair do?
Wholesale trade: printers exchanged inventories, developed credit clearing; still operating
What is the Index Librorum Prohibitorum?
Catholic list of banned books (1559-1966); included Copernicus, Galileo, Descartes, Voltaire
Royal chartered monopoly on English printing (1557); private-sector censorship mechanism
Why did the Reformation spread so fast?
Print amplified it: 95 Theses across Germany in weeks; Luther's German pamphlets ~300,000 copies by 1523
Designed Roman typeface (Venice, 1469) — basis of all modern serif fonts; replaced Gothic blackletter
Aldus Manutius, Venice, 1490s-1515; pocket books, italic type, modern trade publishing model
No international copyright; books banned in one country freely printed and shipped from another
